en.headline: Modified fishing boats begin passenger trips under leisure fishery scheme
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said two converted vessels started operating experience tours from Aberdeen on Thursday, allowing passengers to watch hauling and taste the catch.

zh.headline: 改裝漁船開展休閒漁業體驗團 市民可出海觀起網
zh.dek: 漁護署表示兩艘符合載客安全規格的改裝漁船周四起於香港仔營運體驗團，讓乘客近距離觀看起網並試食漁獲。

en.headline: Windy weekend ahead with mainly cloudy skies and occasional rain patches
en.dek: The Observatory said Saturday and Sunday will see east to northeast winds of force 5 to 6, occasionally stronger offshore, with temperatures between 25 and 28 degrees.

zh.headline: 周末風勢頗大 大致多雲間中有雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示周六日吹東至東北風5至6級，離岸及高地間中更強，氣溫介乎25至28度。

en.headline: New World removes Emperor Theatre relief over collapse risk, studies restoration
en.dek: The developer said the 8-metre Chan Mi Dong Zhuo artwork on the Grade 1 North Point building had structural problems and was removed with Buildings Department approval.

zh.headline: 新世界因倒塌風險移除皇都戲院浮雕 正研究修復
zh.dek: 發展商表示北角一級歷史建築正門8米高「蟬迷董卓」浮雕有結構問題，已獲屋宇署批准移除並妥善存放。

en.headline: Police arrest nine over guess-who phone scams targeting elderly, recover all funds
en.dek: West Kowloon officers dismantled a syndicate in an operation from mid-October to 4 November, seizing phones after six victims aged 73 to 86 lost about HK$325,000.

zh.headline: 警方破「猜猜我是誰」電騙集團 拘9人起回全數逾32萬元
zh.dek: 西九龍總區10月中至11月4日行動，針對6名73至86歲長者，損失約32.5萬元已全數追回。

en.headline: Law firm reportedly to move from Central to Hysan Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: Market sources say Woo Kwan Lee & Lo has reserved about 39,000 square feet in the Causeway Bay development after more than 50 years in Jardine House.

zh.headline: 有消息指律師行將由中環遷往希慎利園八期
zh.dek: 市場消息稱胡關李羅律師行預留約3.9萬平方英尺，結束在怡和大廈超過50年的租用。

en.headline: Lantau Yacht Club Boat Show opens today as public part of Festival of Connoisseurs
en.dek: The free-admission event at Discovery Bay runs until 8 November with more than 30 yachts on display and marine technology booths, linked to the AsiaWorld-Expo luxury exhibition.

zh.headline: 大嶼山遊艇會船展今日開幕 屬鑑賞家盛典公開部分
zh.dek: 愉景灣活動至8日免費入場（需預先登記），展出逾30艘遊艇及海事科技，並與亞洲國際博覽館奢華展覽相連。

en.headline: Water Supplies Department says Shau Kei Wan black particles are asphalt and meet standards
en.dek: The department said samples from affected areas contained trace asphalt from pipe linings raised during post-repair flushing, but all met Hong Kong drinking water standards and supply has cleared.

zh.headline: 水務署指筲箕灣食水黑點為瀝青 化驗符合標準
zh.dek: 署方表示受影響地區樣本含維修後沖洗揚起的微量瀝青，但全部符合香港食水標準，供水已回復清澈。

en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart opens this weekend at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free three-day event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza A and B features workshops, lion dance, martial arts and traditional music from 6 to 8 November.

zh.headline: 非物質文化遺產市集周末在文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 一連三日免費活動於香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區舉行，設有工作坊、舞獅、武術及傳統音樂表演。

en.headline: 61-year-old worker dies after being struck by vehicle at Sha Tin site
en.dek: The Labour Department is investigating after a female worker was run over by a grab lorry while washing vehicle tyres at a construction site entrance near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday.

zh.headline: 沙田工地女工被抓斗貨車輾斃 勞工處展開調查
zh.dek: 一名61歲女工周四上午在沙田路近博康邨地盤出入口沖洗車胎時，被抓斗貨車輾過身亡，勞工處已發出暫時停工通知書。

en.headline: Police to introduce AI facial recognition on SmartView CCTV this month
en.dek: The force said the feature, tested on missing elderly cases and a robbery, will expand coverage toward 60,000 cameras by 2028, with several malls agreeing to link systems.

zh.headline: 警方銳眼計劃本月加入人工智能人臉識別
zh.dek: 行動部高級警司梁銘亮表示，系統已測試協助尋回失智長者及偵破行劫案，並有多個商場同意今年內接入，目標2028年約六萬支鏡頭。

en.headline: M+ at Night returns Friday with RubberBand and live performances
en.dek: The museum’s evening programme on 6 November features Cantopop group RubberBand, indie band Goodnight Lillie and the Recycled Orchestra of Cateura until midnight.

zh.headline: M+夜不同周五回歸 RubberBand等樂隊演出
zh.dek: 西九文化區M+周五晚上舉行夜不同活動，至午夜有RubberBand、Goodnight Lillie及Recycled Orchestra of Cateura演出。

en.headline: National Security Department arrests 34-year-old man over seditious book imports
en.dek: Police detained a local company director in Mong Kok on Thursday on suspicion of importing publications with seditious intention under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance.

zh.headline: 國安處旺角拘捕34歲男子 涉輸入煽動書籍
zh.dek: 警方周四在旺角拘捕一名本地公司董事，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》輸入具煽動意圖的刊物。

en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after five-month-old baby found unconscious in Yuen Long
en.dek: Police detained a domestic helper on suspicion of child abuse after a five-month-old girl was found unconscious at a village house in Ha San Wai on Thursday evening.

zh.headline: 元朗五個月大女嬰昏迷送院 外傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 周四晚上元朗下新圍村一名五個月大女嬰被發現昏迷，警方以涉嫌虐兒拘捕一名外傭。

en.headline: Kwun Tong grandmother jailed 20 days for slapping five-year-old
en.dek: Leung Lai-ha, 68, admitted assaulting a girl at APM mall after a basketball dispute involving her grandson and was sentenced by the magistrate on Thursday.

zh.headline: 觀塘APM商場婆婆摑五歲女童判監20日
zh.dek: 68歲梁麗霞承認在孫兒與女童爭籃球後襲擊對方，周四被裁判官判監20日兼罰款3000元。

en.headline: Director and firm plead guilty in HK$52.9m bottled water contract fraud
en.dek: Lui Tsz-chung and Xin Ding Xin Trade admitted submitting altered certificates to win a government contract supplying drinking water to civil servants.

zh.headline: 內地公司及董事承認政府瓶裝水合約詐騙 涉5290萬元
zh.dek: 雷子聰及鑫鼎鑫商貿承認向政府物流署提交經改動證書，以取得向公務員供應飲用水的合約。

en.headline: Overall crime rises 2.1 percent in first three quarters, driven by fraud
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said 68,015 cases were recorded from January to September, with fraud accounting for nearly half at 34,679 cases.

zh.headline: 首三季罪案升2.1% 詐騙案帶動整體上升
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，今年1月至9月錄得68015宗罪案，詐騙案佔近一半，共34679宗。

en.headline: Department of Justice launches HK$20,000 lawtech subscription scheme
en.dek: Small law firms and newly qualified barristers can claim up to HK$20,000 for one-year subscriptions to designated legal technology services until 29 January.

zh.headline: 律政司推出兩萬元法律科技訂購資助計劃
zh.dek: 中小型律師事務所及年資較淺大律師可獲最多兩萬元資助，訂購一年指定法律科技服務，申請期至明年1月29日。

en.headline: Customs raids seven illicit cigarette retail points, arrests 10
en.dek: Officers posing as customers seized about 128,000 sticks worth HK$580,000 during a three-day territory-wide operation targeting newsstands and stalls.

zh.headline: 海關搗破七個私煙零售點 拘捕十人
zh.dek: 關員喬裝顧客三日全港行動，檢獲約12.8萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約58萬元。

en.headline: AFCD launches dual-use fishing boat pilot for leisure tours
en.dek: Two modified vessels will offer guided trips from Aberdeen where visitors can watch net hauling and learn about local fish species.

zh.headline: 漁護署推「漁＋樂」漁船計劃 示範船載客出海
zh.dek: 兩艘改裝漁船將於香港仔水域提供導賞團，讓市民近距離觀看起網及認識本地魚種。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific to pay one-month discretionary bonus to eligible Hong Kong staff
en.dek: Eligible Hong Kong-based employees will receive the 2026 bonus equivalent to one month of qualifying pay on 7 January, the airline said in an internal message.

zh.headline: 國泰向香港合資格員工發放一個月酌情花紅
zh.dek: 航空公司在內部訊息中表示，常駐香港的合資格員工將於明年1月7日獲發相當於一個月合資格薪酬的2026年度酌情花紅。

en.headline: CHP infection control head issued warning over driving conviction
en.dek: The Medical Council ordered a warning letter for Dr Edmond Ma Siu-keung after he failed to report a 2024 dangerous-driving conviction within 28 days.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心感染控制主管因危駕定罪被醫委會發警告信
zh.dek: 馬紹強醫生因未在28日內向醫委會申報2024年危險駕駛定罪，周四紀律研訊後被下令發出警告信。

en.headline: Federated Hermes opens Hong Kong office in Central
en.dek: The US asset manager, which manages US$884 billion, has set up in the Nexxus Building after two years of preparation to deepen Asia-Pacific ties.

zh.headline: Federated Hermes在中環開設香港辦公室
zh.dek: 這家管理8840億美元資產的美國資產管理公司經過兩年籌備後，在Nexxus大廈設立辦事處，加強亞太聯繫。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.67 percent higher at 24796.98
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rose nearly 880 points on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Tech Index gaining 5.55 percent amid broad strength in technology shares.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市升3.67%報24796.98點
zh.dek: 港股周四上升近880點，恒生科技指數升5.55%，科網股普遍造好。

en.headline: Man arrested after Yuen Long rooftop standoff following alleged assault
en.dek: Police detained a 39-year-old man on suspicion of wounding after he was persuaded from a rooftop on Kik Yeung Road, where a woman had been injured earlier.

zh.headline: 元朗男子危坐天台後被捕 涉傷人
zh.dek: 警方在擊壤路勸服一名39歲男子離開天台後，以涉嫌傷人拘捕他；一名50歲女子較早時頸手受傷送院。

en.headline: Female road worker killed by dump truck in Sha Tin
en.dek: A woman died after a dump truck struck and ran over her at a road-widening site on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday morning. Police are investigating.

zh.headline: 沙田路修路女工遭泥頭車輾斃
zh.dek: 周四早上沙田路近博康邨路面擴闊工地，一名女工遭泥頭車撞倒輾過後當場死亡，警方正調查。

en.headline: Education Bureau says TSA student performance remains steady
en.dek: Primary 3 and Secondary 3 results in Chinese, English and Mathematics were generally stable this year and aligned with previous assessments, the bureau said after receiving the HKEAA report.

zh.headline: 教育局：系統評估學生中英數表現保持平穩
zh.dek: 考評局提交的2026年全港性系統評估報告顯示，小三及中三學生在中、英、數科表現大致平穩，與上次結果相若。

en.headline: High Court sentences Joshua Wong to 10 years for foreign collusion
en.dek: The 30-year-old activist, already serving a term for subversion, received the concurrent sentence after pleading guilty to conspiring with Nathan Law and others to lobby for sanctions.

zh.headline: 高等法院判黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力罪名成立 判監10年
zh.dek: 30歲的黃之鋒早前承認控罪，新刑期與現正服刑的顛覆罪刑期同期執行，他原定明年1月刑滿。

en.headline: HAVF home audio-visual festival opens tomorrow at Kowloon Tong InnoCentre
en.dek: The free two-day event features LG, Sony and other brands demonstrating televisions, soundbars and home cinema systems from 6 to 7 November.

zh.headline: HAVF視聽娛樂祭明起於九龍塘創新中心舉行
zh.dek: 為期兩日的免費活動將於11月6日至7日舉行，現場有LG、Sony等品牌示範電視、Soundbar及家庭影院系統。

en.headline: Man arrested after alleged tile assault in Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 53-year-old man was detained on suspicion of wounding after police said he used a tile to strike a 48-year-old man late Wednesday night in Sheung Shui.

zh.headline: 上水醉漢涉用瓷磚襲擊途人被捕
zh.dek: 一名53歲男子涉嫌傷人被捕，警方指他周三深夜在上水以瓷磚襲擊一名48歲男子，傷者面嘴受傷送院。

en.headline: VTC opens applications for 2027/28 programmes with expanded places
en.dek: The Vocational Training Council begins accepting applications today for about 140 full-time programmes, increasing overall study places by more than 10 percent to over 14,000.

zh.headline: 職業訓練局今日起接受2027/28學年課程申請 學額增逾一成
zh.dek: 職訓局今日起接受約140項全日制課程報名，整體學額增加超過一成至逾14,000個，方便中六學生規劃升學。

en.headline: Hong Kong Optical Fair continues with seminars and smart eyewear displays
en.dek: The three-day trade event at HKCEC features more than 600 exhibitors from 14 countries, with programmes on functional eyewear running today.

zh.headline: 香港國際眼鏡展續展 智能眼鏡及功能鏡片成焦點
zh.dek: 為期三日的商貿展在會展舉行，逾600間來自14個國家及地區的參展商參與，今日有功能眼鏡研討環節。

en.headline: Driver arrested after FEHD contractor truck hits pedestrian in North Point
en.dek: A 45-year-old man was detained on suspicion of dangerous driving causing serious injury after his medium goods vehicle struck a 60-year-old woman on King's Road late Wednesday.

zh.headline: 北角食環署外判貨車撞途人 45歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 一名45歲男子涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕，其駕駛的中型貨車周三深夜在英皇道撞倒一名60歲女途人。

en.headline: HKU Faculty of Arts launches inaugural Being Human Festival
en.dek: The free public programme runs until 15 November with workshops, performances and talks under the theme Crossroads at venues including Tai Hang.

zh.headline: 港大文學院首辦「人文藝術節」今日起至15日
zh.dek: 主題「十字路口」的免費公眾活動包括工作坊、表演及對談，場地涵蓋大坑等地。

en.headline: HKTDC Wine and Spirits Fair opens today at HKCEC with over 620 exhibitors
en.dek: The 18th edition runs until Saturday, with a public tasting zone open on the final day for visitors aged 18 and above.

zh.headline: 香港國際美酒展今日在會展開幕 逾620間參展商參與
zh.dek: 第18屆展覽至周六結束，最後一天設公眾品酒區，18歲或以上人士可入場。

en.headline: LegCo passes crypto-asset reporting bill to boost tax transparency
en.dek: The Inland Revenue Amendment Bill implements the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework from 2027 and updated Common Reporting Standard from 2028.

zh.headline: 立法會通過加密資產申報修訂條例 提升稅務透明度
zh.dek: 《稅務（修訂）（加密資產申報框架及經修訂共同申報標準）條例草案》通過，CARF由2027年起實施，經修訂CRS由2028年起生效。

en.headline: World Class University Presidents Forum opens at HKUST
en.dek: Acting Chief Executive Chan Kwok-ki officiates at the two-day event bringing together leaders from about 50 top universities to discuss higher education innovation.

zh.headline: 世界頂尖大學校長論壇在科大開幕
zh.dek: 署理行政長官陳國基主禮為期兩日的論壇，匯聚約50所頂尖大學領導，共商高等教育創新發展。

en.headline: Poon Hao-ran claims Hong Kong's first Youth Olympics gold in wushu
en.dek: The 15-year-old wushu athlete scored 18.720 in the men's combined Taijiquan and Taijishan final in Dakar, marking the city's historic first gold at the Games.

zh.headline: 潘浩然青奧武術奪金 港隊史上首面青年奧運金牌
zh.dek: 15歲武術運動員在達喀爾男子太極拳太極扇全能決賽以18.720分奪金，為香港在青年奧運取得歷史上首面金牌。

en.headline: Anti-ram bollards installation begins outside Sogo in Causeway Bay
en.dek: Workers had installed four fixed bollards by Wednesday afternoon along the pavement outside the department store as part of a HK$5 million project against vehicle-ramming risks.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣崇光百貨外防撞柱安裝工程展開
zh.dek: 周三下午工人已在百貨公司外行人路安裝四支固定防撞柱，屬約500萬元項目，旨在防範車輛衝撞風險。

en.headline: Choi rejects push for year-long university internships amid AI shifts
en.dek: Education secretary tells LegCo that reforming four-year degrees into three years of study plus one of full-time internships would risk turning higher education into vocational training.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮反對大學改「三加一」強制一年實習
zh.dek: 教育局局長在立法會表示，將四年制改為三年課堂加一年全職實習，有違大學價值，易令高等教育淪為職業訓練。

en.headline: Electronic advance medical directives to go live on eHealth next year
en.dek: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said in a written reply that residents will be able to create, store and revoke directives electronically on the platform in phases, with the same legal effect as paper.

zh.headline: 預設醫療指示明年可在醫健通電子化訂立
zh.dek: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡書面回覆指，市民可分階段在平台訂立、儲存及撤銷指示，電子版與紙本具同等法律效力。

en.headline: ICAC charges former HKEX vice-president and mother over confidential access
en.dek: Geoffrey Tong and his mother face one count of dishonest computer access after share trades yielded profits exceeding HK$500,000, the ICAC said.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴前港交所副總裁及其母親涉不誠實取用內部系統
zh.dek: 董柏涵與母親梁耀珍被控一項為不誠實目的取用電腦罪，其後股票交易獲利逾50萬港元，廉署表示。

en.headline: Police arrest 11 in Strongjab operation against money-laundering syndicate
en.dek: Officers detained eight men and three women aged 19 to 43 over a network that processed about HK$70 million linked to 85 scam cases.

zh.headline: 警方「猛刺」行動拘11人 破洗黑錢集團涉85宗騙案
zh.dek: 警方拘捕8男3女，年齡介乎19至43歲，集團涉嫌處理約7000萬元犯罪得益，牽涉85宗騙案損失逾2400萬元。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.67 percent higher at 23,919.50
en.dek: The benchmark recovered from an early drop to finish 393.53 points up on Wednesday, with the day’s high matching the close.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升1.67% 報23919.50點
zh.dek: 周三恒指由早段低開回升，全日升393.53點，高位與收市水平相同。

en.headline: Red flags hoisted at four beaches over big waves
en.dek: Leisure and Cultural Services Department warns swimmers away from Stanley Main Beach, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second Beach on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 四個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署周三表示，赤柱正灘、大浪灣、銀線灣及清水灣第二灘因大浪懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客勿下水。

en.headline: Law says government must balance market and fans on ticket scalping rules
en.dek: Culture secretary tells LegCo that any tighter controls on consignment tickets or real-name systems will be studied carefully so as not to deter event organisers.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩指打擊黃牛須平衡市場運作與觀眾體驗
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長書面回覆立法會，指任何收緊內部門票比例或實名制安排均須審慎考慮，以免令主辦單位卻步。

en.headline: Tang says restricted management at Huanggang port maximises limited space
en.dek: Security Bureau chief says the Hong Kong side of the rebuilt port uses closed-area controls like other land borders, with weekday crossings averaging over 86,000.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指皇崗口岸港方禁區式管理最有效運用有限空間
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示，重建後皇崗口岸港方口岸區實施禁區式管理，平日日均出入境人次平均超過8萬6千人。

en.headline: Po Pin Chau reservation trial held daily visitors to about 950 during National Day
en.dek: Environment secretary says the pilot scheme on the High Island Geo-Trail section successfully controlled numbers and improved order at the viewing platform.

zh.headline: 破邊洲預約制試行國慶期間日均到訪約950人
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長表示，萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行預約制有效控制人數，觀景台最高人流減逾三成。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index opens 0.32 percent lower at 23,452
en.dek: The benchmark dropped 74 points in early trading on Wednesday as technology and consumer shares weighed on sentiment.

zh.headline: 恒生指數低開0.32% 報23452點
zh.dek: 周三早段恒指下跌74點，科技及消費股拖累氣氛，投資者關注美國中期選舉結果。

en.headline: Hong Kong Tourism Board launches Gourmet Month with over 400 venues
en.dek: The month-long campaign running through 30 November features limited-time menus and promotions at restaurants and bars across the city.

zh.headline: 旅發局推出香港美食月 逾400間餐廳酒吧參與
zh.dek: 為期一個月的活動至11月30日止，全城餐廳及酒吧推出限定菜單及優惠。

en.headline: Chan says Hong Kong offers businesses growth and long-term capital
en.dek: Financial Secretary tells investors at the Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit that the city connects capital across corporate life cycles.

zh.headline: 陳茂波稱香港為企業提供增長機會及長期資本
zh.dek: 財政司司長在國際金融領袖投資峰會向投資者表示，香港可連接企業不同階段所需的資本。

en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale giant puppets
en.dek: The free two-day youth arts festival at Victoria Park on 14 and 15 November features an illuminated night parade and a finale with ten four-metre puppets.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華重返銅鑼灣 童話巨型木偶亮相維園
zh.dek: 11月14及15日免費兩日青年藝術節於維多利亞公園舉行，包括夜間燈飾巡遊及十個四米高巨型木偶壓軸巡遊。

en.headline: Fire at Richland Gardens in Kowloon Bay evacuates about 150 residents
en.dek: Three people were taken to hospital for suspected smoke inhalation after a blaze broke out in a low-floor unit early on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 九龍灣麗晶花園單位火警 約150名住客疏散
zh.dek: 周三凌晨低層單位起火，三人懷疑吸入濃煙送院，消防正調查起火原因。

en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor sentenced to 2.5 years for unlawful sex with minor
en.dek: The District Court imposed the term on Tuesday after Sei Chun-hing was convicted of intercourse with a girl under 16 in 2011.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施駿興非法性交罪成判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院周二判刑，施駿興早前被裁定2011年與未滿16歲女童性交罪成。

en.headline: Central Government approves removal of housing chief Winnie Ho
en.dek: The State Council accepted Chief Executive John Lee’s recommendation on Tuesday, formalising Ho’s departure after she resigned over the Tai Po fire.

zh.headline: 中央政府批准免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 國務院周二根據行政長官李家超建議正式免職，何永賢早前因大埔宏福苑火災請辭承擔政治責任。

en.headline: Spanish restaurant Lola María opens second branch on Gresson Street in Wan Chai
en.dek: Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona’s new outlet began service on 3 November, adding Wan Chai-exclusive dishes alongside the Sheung Wan original’s menu.

zh.headline: 西班牙餐廳Lola María於灣仔機利臣街開設第二分店
zh.dek: 主廚Edgard Sanuy Barahona的新店於11月3日開始營業，在上環原店菜式以外加入灣仔限定菜式。

en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Hong Kong Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Broadway adaptation of Roald Dahl’s story begins its Hong Kong run today at the Grand Theatre, with performances through 6 December.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇今起於香港文化中心上演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾作品的百老匯音樂劇，由今日起至十二月六日於尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院公演。

en.headline: Software update triggers four-hour parking meter outage across Hong Kong
en.dek: Transport Department says about 11,000 meters failed after an early software update on Tuesday; system restored by 12.15pm with full refunds arranged.

zh.headline: 凌晨軟件更新致全港咪錶系統故障約四小時
zh.dek: 運輸署指約一萬一千個咪錶受影響，系統於下午十二時十五分恢復，營運商將安排全數退款。

en.headline: UK exempts Hong Kong BN(O) visa holders from proposed 10-year settlement wait
en.dek: British Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood confirmed BN(O) applicants keep their five-year path to settlement but face stricter English-language and criminality requirements.

zh.headline: 英國豁免BNO簽證持有人 不受擬議十年定居期影響
zh.dek: 內政大臣沙巴娜·馬哈茂德確認BNO申請人維持五年定居途徑，但仍須符合更嚴格的英語及品行要求。

en.headline: Local animation Odium Zero holds Hong Kong premiere ahead of cinema screenings
en.dek: The AI-assisted sci-fi work supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency screened its extended first episode on Monday, with special screenings starting 7 November.

zh.headline: 本地動畫《無涯之約》舉行香港首映 11月7日起特別放映
zh.dek: 文創產業發展處支持的人工智能輔助科幻動畫周一首映加長版第一話，本周五起在指定戲院進行特別放映。

en.headline: Health officials urge measles precautions for travellers amid global outbreaks
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection says Hong Kong has recorded nine measles cases this year, mostly imported, and advises checking vaccination status before travel.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心籲外遊市民防麻疹 今年本港錄9宗個案
zh.dek: 中心指本港今年暫錄9宗麻疹，六宗與輸入有關，呼籲計劃外遊者出發前查閱目的地疫情並確保已接種兩劑疫苗。

en.headline: John Lee begins Beijing visit, meets municipal leaders on Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Chief Executive tours the Beijing Municipal Administrative Center and meets Yin Li and Yin Yong to discuss co-operation under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

zh.headline: 李家超展開北京訪問 晤尹力尹勇談北部都會區合作
zh.dek: 行政長官參觀北京城市副中心並與北京市委書記尹力及市長尹勇會面，討論十五五規劃下的合作。

en.headline: Water supply to three buildings in Jordan interrupted after pipe bursts
en.dek: Water Supplies Department expects drinking water to Highview Terrace and Hong Yuen Court to resume around 6am on Wednesday after a main burst on Tak Shing Street.

zh.headline: 佐敦德成街食水管爆裂 高景臺及康源閣三座大廈暫停供水
zh.dek: 水務署指維修鹹水管期間食水管突然爆裂，預計周三早上約六時恢復高景臺及康源閣食水供應。

en.headline: Government defers proxy-vote caps for owners’ meetings after consultation
en.dek: Home and Youth Affairs Bureau says more than half of 550 submissions opposed limits, so it will first strengthen spot checks and verification following the Tai Po fire.

zh.headline: 民青局暫不設業主大會授權票上限 諮詢未達共識
zh.dek: 局方指550份意見中逾半反對設上限，將先加強抽查核實；措施與大埔宏福苑火災後的大廈管理改革有關。

en.headline: Tang says joint task force will seek bid-rigging clues at owners’ meetings
en.dek: Security Secretary tells lawmakers officers will use surveillance and attend corporation meetings to intervene early in building maintenance cases.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強稱特遣隊會到業主大會尋找圍標線索
zh.dek: 保安局局長向立法會議員表示，執法人員會出席業主立案法團會議並以監視等方式及早介入樓宇維修個案。

en.headline: Five Hong Kong universities in Asia’s top 10 as HKU retains first place
en.dek: QS Asia rankings place City University fourth and Chinese University fifth, with three local institutions in the top five for the first time in more than a decade.

zh.headline: QS亞洲大學排名港五校入十強 港大蟬聯榜首
zh.dek: 城大升至第四、中大第五，本港三間大學相隔逾十年再同時位列亞洲五強。

en.headline: Hong Kong retail sales rise 6.4 per cent in September, 17th straight month of growth
en.dek: Provisional figures show total sales value at HK$33.4 billion, with online sales up 12 per cent and jewellery leading category gains.

zh.headline: 本港9月零售業銷貨值按年升6.4% 連升17個月
zh.dek: 臨時估計總銷貨價值334億元，網上銷售升12%，珠寶鐘錶等類別升幅顯著。

en.headline: Special traffic arrangements for World Triathlon Cup in Central and Wan Chai
en.dek: Transport Department says Expo Drive will close from Wednesday and further road closures will apply near the harbourfront on Saturday and Sunday.

zh.headline: 三項鐵人世界盃中區及灣仔分階段實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署指博覽道由周三起封閉，周六及周日中環海濱及灣仔北一帶將進一步封路改道。

en.headline: Hong Kong airport launches single check-in for Hangzhou and Wuhan flights
en.dek: Passengers from the two mainland cities can now check baggage through to overseas destinations via Hong Kong even when changing airlines.

zh.headline: 香港機場啟動杭州武漢聯動一張機票行李直掛服務
zh.dek: 由杭州或武漢出發經香港飛往海外的旅客，即使轉乘不同航空公司，亦可一次辦理登機手續，行李直掛目的地。

en.headline: Hong Kong economy grows 5.2% in third quarter, fastest nine-month pace in five years
en.dek: Advance estimates show real GDP up 5.2% year on year in Q3 and 1.9% on a seasonally adjusted basis, driven by exports and domestic demand.

zh.headline: 本港第三季經濟預估按年增長5.2% 首三季增速創五年最快
zh.dek: 預先估計數字顯示實質本地生產總值按年升5.2%，經季節調整後按季升1.9%，由出口及內部需求帶動。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 132 points for third consecutive gain
en.dek: The benchmark ended at 23,525.97 on Tuesday, rising 0.57% on turnover of more than HK$236 billion as consumer and gaming stocks led gains.

zh.headline: 恒生指數高收132點 連升三日
zh.dek: 周二收報23525.97點，升幅近0.6%，成交額逾2364億元，消費及博彩股帶動升勢。

en.headline: He Lifeng and John Lee address Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit
en.dek: Vice-Premier pledged continued support for Hong Kong as a free open financial centre and more offshore yuan liquidity; Lee said the five-year plan offers investors certainty.

zh.headline: 何立峰與李家超在國際金融領袖投資峰會致辭
zh.dek: 副總理表示將繼續支持香港作為自由開放金融中心並增加離岸人民幣流動性；李家超指五年規劃為投資者提供確定性。

en.headline: Broadway musical Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens in Hong Kong tomorrow
en.dek: The production based on Roald Dahl’s novel runs at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre from 4 November to 6 December, tickets from HK$388.

zh.headline: 百老匯音樂劇《朱古力獎門人》明日香港開演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾小說的製作由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，票價由388港元起。

en.headline: Parking meter system restored after nearly four-hour outage
en.dek: Transport Department says the citywide system is back to normal after emergency repairs; no evidence of attack, and operator must submit a report within 24 hours.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統已恢復正常運作
zh.dek: 運輸署指營運商緊急搶修後系統復常，暫無證據顯示遭攻擊，並要求盡快提交報告。

en.headline: Red flags hoisted at Stanley, Big Wave Bay and Clear Water Bay beaches
en.dek: Leisure and Cultural Services Department cites big waves; beachgoers advised not to swim at the three sites in Southern and Sai Kung districts.

zh.headline: 赤柱正灘、大浪灣及清水灣第二灣泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署因大浪關係懸掛紅旗，呼籲市民勿在港島南區及西貢區這三個泳灘游泳。

en.headline: Yuen Long district councillor jailed 2.5 years for sex with 13-year-old
en.dek: District Court judge notes lack of remorse in sentencing Sei Chun-hing over an offence from more than a decade ago; he was acquitted of a related indecent-assault count.

zh.headline: 元朗區議員施振興因與13歲女童發生性行為判囚兩年半
zh.dek: 區域法院法官指被告缺乏悔意；事件發生於十多年前，另控非禮則被裁定罪名不成立。

en.headline: Parking meter system fails across Hong Kong, police hold off enforcement
en.dek: Transport Department says emergency repairs are under way after the operator reported a malfunction at 8.20am; Secretary Mable Chan says police will not ticket roadside spaces until fixed.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統故障 警方暫不執法路旁泊位
zh.dek: 運輸署接獲營運商早上約8時20分報告系統故障，正緊急搶修；陳美寶指未完全復修前警方不會就路旁咪錶位執法。

en.headline: State Council removes Ho Wing-yin as Housing Bureau Secretary
en.dek: The formal removal follows her resignation last week to take political responsibility for the Tai Po fire, with Michael Wong acting in the post.

zh.headline: 國務院決定免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 何永賢上月為大埔宏福苑火災承擔政治責任請辭，財政司副司長黃偉綸兼任署理局長。

en.headline: Central Government removes Winnie Ho as Housing Secretary
en.dek: The State Council approved the removal on Tuesday following her resignation to take political responsibility for the Wang Fuk Court fire.

zh.headline: 國務院決定免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 中央人民政府周二根據行政長官建議，正式免去何永賢房屋局局長一職，她早前為宏福苑火災承擔政治責任請辭。

en.headline: Parking meter system fails across Hong Kong, police hold off enforcement
en.dek: Transport officials said the operator reported the outage at about 8.20am; Secretary Chen Mei-bo confirmed police would not ticket roadside meter spaces until repairs are complete.

zh.headline: 全港咪錶泊車系統故障 陳美寶稱未完全復修前警方暫不執法
zh.dek: 運輸署今早約8時20分接獲營辦商報告系統故障，正緊急搶修；運輸及物流局局長表示警方在系統完全復修前不會對路旁咪錶位執法。
